hero.subtitle: Sovereign AI, NCA-aligned security, governed AI agents and verifiable records for ministries and public entities, from one accountable Saudi partner.

context.title: Where we play
context.body: Government is one of our two strongest fits, across almost the whole portfolio. Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, Intelligent Operations and Blockchain are primary fits, and IoT & Edge is relevant. We have a clear, low-risk first engagement in the sector: an NCA gap assessment or a Sovereign AI readiness assessment.

challenges.title: Sovereign AI for regulated workloads
challenges.body: Government and ministries are a destination for the dedicated, single-tenant Sovereign AI Factory, air-gapped where required.

challenges.title: NCA ECC and DCC
challenges.body: NCA ECC applies to government entities and critical national infrastructure, and DCC to entities handling classified and sensitive data.

challenges.title: Asset inventory and spending efficiency
challenges.body: NCA ECC requires an accurate, current inventory of technology assets, and EXPRO is driving spending efficiency across government.

challenges.title: Verifiable public records
challenges.body: Saudi regulators are already putting property titles, trade and food supply chains on shared ledgers.

useCases.title: NCA gap assessment
useCases.body: Gap assessment, remediation roadmap, policy set and self-assessment support against NCA ECC.

useCases.title: Sovereign AI readiness
useCases.body: A Sovereign AI Readiness Assessment: use-case portfolio and value case, data classification and residency, and regulatory mapping.

useCases.title: Traceable sensitive documents
useCases.body: Screen, file and print watermarking, so every copy is traceable to user and device.

useCases.title: Trusted digital records
useCases.body: Tamper-proof registries, certificates and contracts, verifiable in seconds by any authorized party.

vision2030.body: Solutions mapped to NCA, SDAIA and sector mandates, with data, AI and ledgers kept in-Kingdom in every model.
